agent_decisions.root_cause: The live site is an ASP.NET postback application. The search results do load successfully, but the scraper's extraction logic is brittle: it assumes detail fields are label/value table rows with labels such as 'Entity Name' and 'Current Status', while the live detail page uses text such as 'Summary for:', 'Entity type:', and 'Identification Number:'. The live status field is not present in the inspected summary. The prior zero-row failure was therefore not caused by HTTP blocking or a missing results grid; it indicates the test execution did not successfully complete the ASP.NET search/postback or used selectors/code from a different page state. The current live selectors produce 25 first-page rows and a page-2 link.

diagnostic_notes: Do not rely on the requested CorpSearchResults.aspx URL before submission; the initial form is CorpSearch.aspx and the results URL appears only after the postback.
Wait explicitly for #MainContent_SearchControl_grdSearchResultsEntity after clicking the submit input.
Use the broader verified detail-link selector a[href*='CorpSummary.aspx']; the class-qualified selector is valid for observed rows but unnecessarily restrictive.

The first result demonstrates that the searched former name can differ from the current detail summary name; preserve both only if needed, and use the listing name for the requested Entity Name if that is the intended search-result value.
Parse detail values from the actual text patterns: 'Summary for:', 'Entity type:', 'Identification Number:', and the Address/City rows under #MainContent_tblPrincipleOffice.
The existing table_field fallback that expects the first cell to equal 'Entity Name' will fail for #MainContent_tblEntity because its content is 'Summary for: ENQUYST TECHNOLOGIES INC.'.
Current Status is not exposed in the inspected summary DOM; emit an empty value plus a missing-field flag rather than inventing one.
Pagination must target numeric postback anchors such as href containing Page$2; do not look for a literal Next link because only '2' was observed.
The results page contains 25 rows for mobius, not 33 on the observed run; total result counts may vary.
Registered-agent and officer tables contain PII and should remain excluded or masked as requested.
confidence_notes: Page 2 was not opened during this inspection, so its exact row count and final pagination state remain unverified.
The observed detail page was the first result and its current entity name differed from the result-grid name because the entity had a recorded name change.
No dedicated Current Status element was visible in the inspected detail page; status may be represented elsewhere for some entity types or may be unavailable.
The browser snapshot's discovered obfuscated JSON requests are not confirmed as corporation-data APIs and should not be used as a data source.
Uses the verified ASP.NET selectors for the entity-name radio button, search input, Begins with dropdown, submit button, results grid, result rows, detail links, and Page$ pagination postbacks.

Detail extraction handles the live text patterns Summary for:, Entity type:, and Identification Number:, and emits an empty Current Status with a missing-field flag when no verified status element exists.
The direct detail_url path is independent of listing discovery and uses DIRECT_INPUT provenance.
Pagination waits for network idle and a changed grid signature, while numeric Page$ links are supported instead of requiring a literal Next link.
Bot-protection markers and HTTP 403/429 responses fail fast without retries; zero-record runs capture diagnostic_screenshot.png and exit with status 1.
Workbook writing preserves custom sheets and prior Extracted Data column headers, including legacy fields, while sanitizing every exported cell to the Excel-safe length.
Reviewer and officer/registered-agent accordions are never opened or extracted; configured masking is applied to extracted text.
